title: The Pearl in the Sea: The Soul Molded into a New Man by Drops from Above
description: A sustained correspondence between cosmic-man, pearl-in-sea, and the human soul-in-body becoming the New Man. Sweet rain-drops from above descend into the receptive depth of the natural; oysters in particular places gather the drop with sweet waters and mold the pearl. Single drop yields a great Iaos-gem; divided drops yield many lesser pearls; divers raise them up to kings. The body's eating is the actual site where heavenly or hellish influx enters the soul.
